item.title: Yamanashi Prefectural Museum: The Region's History, Nature and Culture — Guide
item.description: The Yamanashi Prefectural Museum presents the region’s history, natural environment and culture through engaging, hands-on exhibits, themed around the long relationship between the people of Yamanashi and the land they live on, from the mountains and rivers to the wine and craft traditions. Set within a spacious park with outdoor areas to explore, the museum is designed to be accessible and interactive, making it a good indoor option for families and for visitors wanting deeper context on the region beyond its famous Mount Fuji views.
